scenario.summary: pastes a SKU on one line and a quantity on the next; checks the first pad row holds the SKU with quantity newDefaultQuantity (1).
steps: Quick Order, Add Multiple Items, Paste Multiple
Type validSku, Enter, defaultQuantity, Enter; Add All to Quick List; verify message box
Verify first pad SKU = validSku and first quantity = newDefaultQuantity
assertions: First pad SKU value equals the product SKU
evidence: Independent method (priority 95, no dependsOn): it opens the webstore itself and clears the quick list / cart at the end, so it declares its own needs.

validSku z-2460001 (quickOrderPage!C11): active SimpleProduct 'Black + Decker 6.5 in Corded Angle Grinder', OutOfStockOptions DontTrackInventory, MinimumQuantity 1 / MaximumQuantity 100 (tda rows). The Playwright profile (2026-11-01) saw storefrontProductIndex 0; bin/tda readiness (2026-11-05) reports that the record now qualifies for these needs. Inventory 25 per warehouse row (tda rows dbo.ZnodeInventory). Preferred, not required.

validSku is typed and asserted as the first pad SKU: data product.sku in both places. defaultQuantity 0 and newDefaultQuantity 1 are config. REVIEW: 1 is the quantity Quick Order gives a SKU without a valid quantity; if that is the product's MinimumQuantity, a fallback product with MinimumQuantity > 1 would show it instead (the migrated test could assert product.minQuantity).

Store: openWebstoreUrl opens automation_webStoreUrl (atstage: webstore-z10-atstage, the main store MaxwellsHardware), the same store as the Selenium shoppingCart entries and the Playwright quick-order entries.

Profile: work/profiles/profile.json (2026-11-01) was not run for these Selenium tests (profiled false); product facts come from bin/tda rows dbo.ZnodePimProduct (2026-11-05) and the approved Playwright quick-order entries.
Scanned constant values (locators, report messages, delays) are framework constants: role config, no need.
migrate: Selenium reads Excel tables through TestData.getMap; there is no swap for Selenium.
